changelog:
StoreTap v2.1.0.12.6 UI & Feature Update!

✨ ENHANCEMENTS:
- Utang Tracking: Added instant search, status filtering, and sorting to the Utang Records page.
- Sales Management: Added a powerful search/filter tool on the admin Sales page to easily track sales by specific cashiers and staff.
- Responsive UI: Fine-tuned the license countdown to be unobtrusive on desktop and readable on mobile.
- Navigation Menu: Refactored the desktop sidebar to group admin and settings links into a clean 'More' dropdown to prevent crowding.
